title: Evergreen acquisition sources and uses
prompt:
Prepare Evergreen's sources-and-uses schedule and closing leverage for the next investment-committee review.

Use the July corporate-development investment-committee correspondence, the 7/5 controller-tied IC book, the current data-room export, the diligence review notes, and the approved underwriting policy. Treat the 6/29 banker case as change history only and follow the controller's warning on unapproved assumptions. Tie Alder Ridge's posted unrestricted cash and opening funded debt to the contractor-accounting MCP, while keeping Evergreen's transaction terms tied to the controlling deal sources.

Rebuild the current approved closing uses and size buyer cash and the committed funding sources in the priority established by the diligence decisions. Apply the target-cash delivery, board cash-use cap, minimum buyer cash balance, facility, and seller-note constraints. Reconcile sources to uses, quantify any funding gap, include opening buyer debt and every funded debt source in pro forma funded debt, and calculate closing leverage using the approved covenant EBITDA.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `total_uses`, `buyer_cash_source`, `revolver_source`, `term_loan_source`, `seller_note_source`, `funding_gap`, `pro_forma_funded_debt`, `closing_leverage`. Use dollar values to two decimals and ratios as decimal values to at least four decimals.
